title: Northloop Payments Delivery Reserve Schedule
content:
On every Northloop Payments plan the amount credited to the balance for a sold order is the item subtotal plus shipping, excluding tax, and that sale credit is held as a delivery reserve until its release date. The schedule below sets, per payout plan, how long the delivery reserve runs.

## Schedule

| Payout plan | Payments Starter | Payments Biweekly | Payments Weekly | Payments Daily | Payments Daily Plus | Payments Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sale credit basis | item subtotal plus shipping, excluding tax | item subtotal plus shipping, excluding tax | item subtotal plus shipping, excluding tax | item subtotal plus shipping, excluding tax | item subtotal plus shipping, excluding tax | item subtotal plus shipping, excluding tax |
| Delivery reserve days (calendar days after the delivered date) | 21 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 3 | 3 |
| No-scan release days (calendar days after the promised delivery date) | 30 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| High-value order threshold (sale credit, USD) | 1000.00 | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 5000.00 | 10000.00 | 25000.00 |
| High-value extra hold days (calendar days) | 7 | 7 | 7 | 5 | 3 | 0 |
| Release basis | delivered date plus reserve days, or promised date plus no-scan days | same | same | same | same | same |

## Definitions carried by the schedule

- **Delivery reserve days** — calendar days after an order's delivered date for which its sale credit stays reserved.
- **No-scan release days** — calendar days after the promised delivery date at which a sale credit with no delivered scan is released.
- **Release basis** — the anchor of the delivery reserve release date: the delivered date plus the reserve days, or, for an order with no delivered scan, the promised date plus the no-scan days. It is the same on all six plans.
- **High-value order threshold** — the sale credit (USD) at or above which an extra high-value hold is added to the delivery reserve.
- **High-value extra hold days** — the extra calendar days added to the delivery reserve of a high-value sale.

## Hypothetical readings

- A sale credit of exactly 2500.00 USD on Payments Weekly is at the threshold and so carries the 7 extra days; 2499.99 USD is below it and does not.
- On Payments Enterprise the extra hold is 0 days, so a sale credit at or above 25000.00 USD runs the same 3-day reserve as any other sale.
